text:
nina: FYI security plans to tighten keystore egress ACLs in us-west-2 tomorrow 03:00 UTC. They called out privatelink endpoints — might block onboarding traffic from our warm pools.
ops-bot: Change scheduled by @security: CHG-20241215-255, keystore-egress-acl-tighten-usw2 at 2024-12-15T03:00Z.
rahul: Which CIDRs? warmpool-usw2 = 10.30.64.0/22, spot-onboard = 10.30.68.0/24. They currently hit keystore via privatelink.
tom: If blocked we'll see `keystore:403` during handshake and join retries. Quick mitigation: short-lived allowlist via TF toggle (ttl=3h), 2-node canary, and a fallback host `keystore-fallback.usw2` in another AZ.
r ahul: +1 to TF toggle. Make it a simple boolean flag we can flip back. Also add a CloudWatch alarm: `keystore_handshake_5xx > 2% for 5m`.
cost-ops: Cost callout — expect ~6-10% uplift for the AZ while warmup churns. We will auto-pause mass warmups if onboarding latency > baseline +20% for 10m.
ops-bot: Temporary channel created: #temp/keystore-usw2-acl-canary (auto).
tom: Preflight smoke check: run from bastion: `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -H "X-Node: canary" https://keystore-proxy.internal/handshake` -> 200 expected.
nina: I'll coordinate with security. Action items: @rahul open TF PR with `allowlist_ttl = "3h"`, @tom deploy canary image `gpu-join:canary-20241215`, @cost-ops enable cost guardrail. Be on standby 02:40-03:20 UTC.
rahul: PR opened -> https://git.company/infra/pull/904. 
ops-bot: Watchers: nina, rahul, tom, cost-ops.
nina: Thanks — we'll abort and request an exception if canary shows 403s. Post-run we'll discuss permanent keystore peering for onboarding traffic. :white_check_mark:
